The [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent [[Theron Shan]] utilized a pair of '''bracers''' that stored and fired darts with various properties. The bracers were activated by voice commands, and Shan could trigger any of the "Toxicities"&mdash;of which there were at least ten&mdash;by stating the dart's number.

==Known Toxicities==
*'''Toxicity One''': a standard dart that would render the target unconscious.<ref name="The Lost Suns 2">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 2|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 2]]</ref>
*'''Toxicity Two''': a mind-clouding drug that affected most [[Species/Legends|species]] after about thirty seconds.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
*'''Toxicity Three''': a paralytic agent that would eventually cause the target to pass out after about four minutes.<ref name="The Lost Suns 1" />
*'''Toxicity Seven''': a dart that generated a powerful electric charge, strong enough to knock out species as large as a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
*'''Toxicity Ten''': a dart that seemed to cause its target to collapse in convulsions, though the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Mekhis]] was able to overcome the effects of the dart.<ref name="The Lost Suns 5">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 5]]</ref>
